_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA Corporation is the worldwide leader in visual computing technologies and the inventor of the graphic processing unit, or the GPU.' 'The market for GPUs, MCPs, and application processors that support PMPs, PDAs, cellular phones or other handheld devices is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'Additionally, we expect that Intel and AMD will extend this strategy to other segments, including the possibility of successfully integrating a central processing unit, or CPU, and a GPU on the same chip, as evidenced by AMD’s announcement of its Fusion processor project.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and an industry downturn could harm our financial results.' (FY2008 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -64.3%/yr (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +30.0%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.4-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +66.5%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +294.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2008-06-13) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.12x (86.9% downside to Bear $2.79 / +748.3% upside to Bull $180.77) | Adj composite 2.81 vs market 1.05: gap +1.76 [UNDERVALUED] | +8% above the EPP floor $19.65 (15x FY09E $1.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +202.2% total (+101.1%/yr) | At 16.3x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $28.18 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +36.6% YoY in Q1 FY09, forward revenues +36.6% (Q1 FY09 revenue growth (no Q2 FY09 guide in numbers)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
